## Model Links

**diffusion_models** (pick one — pruned is the VRAM-friendly option)

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (20.3 GB)
- [minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_int8_convrot.safetensors) (46.3 GB)
- [minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_bf16.safetensors) (62 GB, max quality)

**loras** (DMD 4-step accelerator — pick one)

- [viggle_animate_dmd_lora_r64.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/resolve/main/loras/viggle_animate_dmd_lora_r64.safetensors) (0.9 GB, recommended)
- [viggle_animate_dmd_lora.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/resolve/main/loras/viggle_animate_dmd_lora.safetensors) (3.6 GB, full rank)

**text_cond**

- [fixed_embed_fwd_anyframe.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/resolve/main/text_cond/fixed_embed_fwd_anyframe.safetensors) — precomputed text conditioning, load with **Load Text Conditioning (Viggle)** (no text encoder needed)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/resolve/main/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors?download=true) (low VRAM)
- or [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── viggle_animate_dmd_lora_r64.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_cond/
│   │   └── fixed_embed_fwd_anyframe.safetensors
│   └── 📂 vae/
│       └── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
```

## Workflow Notes

- Custom nodes required: [ComfyUI-Viggle-Animate-H3](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Viggle-Animate-H3) (Viggle Animate Conditioning + Load Text Conditioning) and [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) (fast preview).
- **Load Video**: set `frame_load_cap` equal to the conditioning node's `length` (e.g. 124) and `force_rate` to 24 — a frame-count mismatch produces mosaic garbage.
- Output resolution follows the driving video; pre-scale it with **Scale Image to Total Pixels** if needed. Keep width/height multiples of 32.
- Sampler: euler, er_sde, exp_heun_2_x0, lcm / simple, normal, beta, bong_tangent 4-8 steps, cfg 1.0, ModelSamplingMiniMaxH3 shift 3.0.

## Report Issue

- issues: [ComfyUI-Viggle-Animate-H3/issues](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Viggle-Animate-H3/issues)

## Viggle Animate — Long Video Loop

### Start
- Load your video at **24 fps** (force) and choose a reference image.
- **124 chunk frames / 22 overlap frames**. The loop handles the chunk count automatically.
- In **Loop Start**, choose a `run_name`: this creates a folder at `output/viggle_chunks/<run_name>/`. Use a new name for each video.
- Turn **resume ON**, keep a fixed sampler `seed`, and leave `rerender_chunk = 0`.
- Leave `initial_state` empty.

### Save and resume
- **Latent checkpoints save automatically after each chunk**, before decoding.
- **resume ON** lets you reuse those checkpoints after cancelling or restarting: keep the same run name and settings, then queue again.
- Completed chunks restore and decode again; unfinished chunks generate.
- To also keep **each chunk as a video**, turn Video Combine’s **save_output ON**. Connect its `filenames` output to Loop End’s `after_save`.
- Changing models, settings or node code can require resampling.

### Watch progress
- **Sample Chunk → live_progress** updates as each chunk samples, restores and decodes.
- `status` outputs are optional text for Show Text; they are not live displays.
- `filename_prefix` connects to your chunk video-saving node’s filename prefix.
- “Loop completed” means all chunks finished; the final video may still be decoding.

### Retry a chunk
- Set `rerender_chunk` to its number (**1 = first chunk**) and choose a different `rerender_seed`.
- That chunk **and all later chunks** regenerate; earlier matching chunks restore.
- Keep that override to keep the take. Set `rerender_chunk = 0` to return to the original seeds.

### Assemble the final video
- **chunk_number = 0:** assemble all saved chunks. A positive number loads one chunk for inspection.
- With Assemble’s `chunks` input connected, the run name is passed automatically.
- With `chunks` disconnected, enter the **same run_name as Loop Start** so Assemble finds the correct folder.
- Decode the assembled latent and save at **24 fps**. Use the driving audio trimmed to the final length.
- Do not concatenate chunk previews—they include overlapping frames.

**Note:** longer videos still need more memory and VAE time. Overlap helps continuity but cannot guarantee no deformation or stutter. Up to 16 ending frames may be trimmed.
